name: Interpolated SDF Gradient Calculation
definition: Calculates the gradient of the SDF at a continuous position within a 4x4x4 voxel block by interpolating gradients computed at the 8 corners of the block.
summary: Interpolated SDF Gradient Calculation computes smooth, continuous derivatives by trilinearly interpolating corner gradients within a fixed 4x4x4 block, differing from nearest-neighbor lookup by ensuring stability for ray marching.
